about_the_game:
You’re a nobody with a still and a dream, stepping into a world where booze means power. Start small, brewing rough batches in a rundown space, and climb your way up to running a thriving underground empire.

Every bottle you brew is in your hands — pour, mix, and package your product in fully interactive first-person gameplay. Refine your techniques, unlock new equipment, and grow your production line to keep up with rising demand.

Sell to shady buyers, strike risky deals, and decide how far you’re willing to go to expand your business. The bigger your operation, the more attention you’ll attract from competitors and the law.

Buy new properties, upgrade your brewing setups, and manage your growing network as your empire stretches across the city. Each expansion brings new opportunities — and new risks.

The underworld rewards ambition, but one wrong move can bring it all crashing down. Will you rise to the top, or lose everything chasing the crown?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5
  • Graphics: RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: A first-person crime sim where you brew, smuggle, and trade your way to the top. Build an illegal booze empire, outsmart rivals, and stay one step ahead of the law.
